description: Visual differences that are allowed, scoped to elements. Each entry has an id, the page pairs it covers ([{ "old": feature/interviewer-portal path, "new": built site path }]), the widths and browsers it covers, one or more selectors, and a reason. The selectors are hidden on both sides of those captures only; everything else on the page is still compared with zero tolerance. An entry whose selectors hide nothing on either side is an error, so a stale entry cannot linger. A whole capture can never be accepted. Add an entry only when a difference has been decided.
